$description: noddo design tokens (W3C Design Tokens format). Primitives + semantic roles for light and dark themes. Source of truth for tokens.css.

rose.$description: Logo nod and illustration ring on Wine or Ink only

wine.$description: Brand scale for website and marketing only. Product UI uses --accent-* roles.

sun.$description: Documented AA exception: white semibold text on fill = 3:1; accent text #8C6000.

categoricalAfterAccent.$description: Series 2-6; series 1 is always the workspace accent. 7+ fold into "Other" in gray-400.

display-site-only.$description: Website, slides, social only. Never in the product.

column-header.$description: Table column header, colour text-tertiary, no uppercase

semantic.$description: Roles. Components read these, never primitives. Accent roles are computed per workspace (see tokens/accent.js).

support.$value: {primitive.color.wine.500} on Wine; #55555C on gray dark surfaces

accent.$description: Workspace accent roles, derived from one HEX. Values shown for the default theme (Wine), light mode.
